lastCompletedStory.title: Thread logEvent into the four sendKeysWhenIdle call sites

nextStoryContext: All four sendKeysWhenIdle call sites (issue.ts/review.ts/spec.ts's runSpec thin-proxy path, and orch-recycle-watch.ts's backstop signal push) now default logEvent to the real file event logger, adapted per-command. src/tmux/dispatch.ts grew two new exports: adaptLogEventForPush(logEvent, uuid) -- a per-caller-uuid variant of src/supervisor/host.ts's own same-named-but-sidecar-fixed-uuid helper, deliberately NOT reused across the two modules (see the patterns.md bullet for why) -- and makePushLogEvent(cwd, uuid), a convenience wrapper composing it with makeFileEventLogger(join(cwd, '.claude', 'cam-worker-events.jsonl')). logEvent moved from SendKeysVerifiedOptions up onto SendKeysWhenIdleOptions (dispatch.ts) so plain sendKeysWhenIdle callers can pass it without widening to the verified-options type. Per-command uuid labels used: 'cli-issue', 'cli-review', 'cli-spec', 'cli-orch-recycle-watch'. orch-recycle-watch.ts's makeSignalPaneFn factory now takes logEvent as an explicit 2nd param (it has no options object in scope, unlike the other three inline call sites) threaded from buildBackstopDeps. A new test in test/issue.test.ts ('runIssue: push-undelivered observability') proves retry exhaustion end-to-end: a hand-rolled fake tmux spawn returns an ever-incrementing display-message cursor-geometry reading (never matching the per-attempt baseline) so sendKeysVerified's delivery verdict never succeeds, forcing all 3 default attempts and asserting exactly one push-undelivered event with { paneId, retriesExhausted: 3 } reaches the injected logEvent sink. Biome's noExcessiveLinesPerFunction (80-line cap) bit hard here: issue.ts/review.ts/spec.ts's run* functions were already near the ceiling, so the fix trimmed surrounding doc-comments rather than extracting new functions (see patterns.md). Raised 4 file-size-budget ceilings (issue.ts 199->209, review.ts 197->207, dispatch.ts 403->451, test/issue.test.ts 357->424); spec.ts and orch-recycle-watch.ts both grew too but were never in the budget file to begin with (not tracked, so no ceiling to raise). No open threads for the next story; this closes out the CAM-359 sendKeysVerified/push-undelivered epic's remaining production-wiring gap.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Purely internal wiring (event-log observability seam threading); no new external library surface exercised beyond what US-001/US-002 already validated for tmux cursor-geometry sampling.
